description: Land Title Settlement Department - Mailawalana,  D/S Division, Matara District - Cad. Map No. 820069 and others
categorisation: This gazette content exclusively deals with land title registration matters under the Registration of Title Act. It contains declarations of determination for specific land parcels, including detailed information about land ownership, parcel numbers, extents, owner identities, and encumbrances. The content appears in "PART III - LANDS" of the gazette and focuses entirely on land registration and title settlement processes, making it a clear example of Land Gazette classification.
